input.direction: Linear Mono dark-neutral SaaS/ops direction (color-palettes: neutral-product) — off-black surfaces with an emerald action/focus color, suited to a dense, always-on warehouse exception console.

hierarchy: Translucent summary panel: exception counts by severity (glanceable state, no CTA)
Exception queue ordered by severity then age
Per-row: severity badge, owner, last update, retry action
Validation/disabled affordances on retry and any filter controls
Secondary metadata (queue filters, pagination) demoted last

claims.text: Severity counts shown in the summary panel (e.g. counts of critical/warning/info exceptions)
claims.evidence: No live warehouse data was provided; counts must be wired to a real feed before ship and labeled as placeholder in any prototype per core-rules anti-slop and content-design invariants.

claims.text: Owner and last-update fields per queue row
claims.evidence: No owner directory or timestamp source was supplied; render as "[owner needed]" / "[timestamp needed]" placeholders until connected to real data.

claims.text: Retry is the primary recovery action for a failed exception
claims.evidence: Reasonable default for an ops exception queue per ui-states async-data guidance (offer retry only when retry can help); confirm against actual failure-mode taxonomy before final copy.

claims.text: Queue can enter a validation-error state on a filter/search input
claims.evidence: Included to satisfy the stated requirement for a validation error state; no real form spec was given, so field name/format rules are placeholders.

unknowns: Refresh/polling cadence and whether retry is synchronous or queued
Real summary counts and time range they represent
Whether supervisors act from phone primarily or wide-screen ops center primarily
content.primaryAction: Triage and retry the highest-severity failed exception
localization: Relative timestamps ("last update") need locale-aware formatting, not hardcoded English strings
Owner names may be longer/shorter across locales; avoid truncation that hides identity
Severity labels and retry/disabled copy must be translated, not encoded only in badge color
Mirror layout and icon direction for RTL locales; queue reading order (severity → owner → time → action) must still hold

responsive.wide: Two-region layout: main exception queue as a data table (severity, owner, last update, retry) in the dominant column; translucent summary panel as a fixed/sticky right rail surfacing severity counts at a glance.
responsive.portrait: Summary panel moves above the queue as a compact horizontal stat band; queue table condenses columns (merge owner+last-update into one line) but keeps tabular structure.
responsive.narrow: Summary counts promoted to the very top as a compact stat row (critical count most prominent); queue table replaced by stacked cards, one per exception, with severity badge and retry button always visible (not hover-revealed); owner/last-update demoted to secondary line inside the card.
recomposition: Promote: summary/critical-count moves earlier as viewport narrows
Replace: table rows become stacked cards on narrow
Regroup: owner + last-update collapse into one secondary metadata line on narrow
Reduce: decorative table borders/dividers removed in favor of card grouping
Change interaction: retry becomes an always-visible tap target instead of a hover-revealed control
responsive.sourceOrder: DOM order matches visual priority at every width: summary panel, then severity, then retry action, then owner/last-update metadata — never rely on CSS reorder to fix a mismatched tab order.

contrastStates: text/bg: #fafafa on #0a0a0a — verify ≥4.5:1 (well above threshold on off-black)
on-action/action: #052e24 on #10b981 — verify ≥4.5:1 for retry button label
border/surface: #a1a1aa on #171717 — verify ≥3:1 for row/card boundaries
focus/every surface: #10b981 focus ring tested against #0a0a0a, #171717, and the translucent panel's composited color, each ≥3:1
danger/surface: #ff8a80 on #171717 for severity/error text — verify ≥4.5:1; on-danger/danger (#000000 on #ff8a80) for any filled danger chip ≥4.5:1
disabled/surface: #a1a1aa disabled retry label on #171717 — target ≥3:1 plus a non-color cue (reduced opacity + removed icon, not color alone)
translucent summary panel: composite panel background (e.g. rgba(23,23,23,0.6)) over #0a0a0a in sRGB before measuring text/icon contrast inside it
inputParity: Retry, filter, and any expand/collapse controls are reachable and operable by keyboard alone, in the same order as visual/reading order
Retry buttons are always rendered (not hover-only) so touch and keyboard users get equal access on the phone card layout
Touch targets ~44×44px minimum for retry and severity-filter chips on narrow layouts
Disabled retry uses native `disabled` (or `aria-disabled` if the control must stay focusable) plus visible non-color cue, not opacity alone
accessibility.reducedMotion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: no shimmer skeleton for queue loading (use a static tonal placeholder instead), no persistent pulse/glow on critical severity badges, retry pending state shown as static label change ("Retrying…") rather than a spinner animation, and any toast/notice timing/transition collapses to nearly-instant per core-rules and ui-states accessibility invariants.
